edits.old: Every error is an RFC 9457 problem response with `messageId` set, `detail` carrying the text with its placeholders filled, and `instance` naming the request. For MSG-P4-002 the {action} value names the action the caller tried, "read the decision log of this case", and never a case fact. A refusal never echoes the rule ID, the version label or the case reference of another tenant's case.
